preconditions.name: vs_tracking_live
preconditions.description: READINESS: region-V_s tracking must be live (per_stream_vs populated), else region_vs is the degenerate constant-1.0 fallback and a 'V_s flat' reading is an artefact -- a false decoupling. Worst-cell max streams tracked during measurement.
preconditions.control: worst cell (min over cells of max streams tracked)

preconditions.name: forward_pe_varies
preconditions.description: READINESS positive control: forward PE must actually vary on the harshened env (best-cell variance). SAME statistic the decoupling verdict routes on (pe_heterogeneous). If flat, the env under-drove uncertainty and the decoupling is untestable.
preconditions.control: best cell (positive control for PE heterogeneity)

preconditions.name: forward_pe_bounded
preconditions.description: READINESS: forward PE bounded (no explosion / NaN). Worst cell mean.

preconditions.name: enough_paired_steps
preconditions.description: READINESS: enough aligned (region_vs, forward_pe) pairs pooled across seeds to estimate the relationship.

null_reading_guide.vs_pe_decoupled_proxy_saturation: H-vs-proxy-saturation CONFIRMED: PE varies while V_s stays flat -> region-V_s decoupled from forward-PE -> reframe MECH-321 R1 trigger toward forward-model disagreement (candidate /claim-synthesis)
null_reading_guide.vs_tracks_uncertainty_not_saturated: H-vs-proxy-saturation REFUTED: region-V_s DOES drop -> not saturated -> env-axis reading (V3-EXQ-816b) governs
null_reading_guide.substrate_not_ready_requeue: forward-PE positive control failed (PE flat / too few pairs) -> env under-drove uncertainty -> needs a harsher env (P-A territory), NOT a decoupling verdict
